description: SEM-TAB-FACTS (SemEval-2021 Task 9) dev and test as a SEPARATE auxiliary validation set holding a not-enough-info class (D-798 item 4). Read at call time by benchmark/adapters/semtabfacts/adapter.py; nothing below is written in code. Never mixed into, sampled with, or reported as a SciTab set or score.

span_fill_values.repeat: a spanning cell's text is written at every grid position its row and column span covers
span_fill_values.first: a spanning cell's text is written at its first position and an empty cell over the rest of its span

report_line: semtabfacts_aux_val (SEM-TAB-FACTS dev and test, auxiliary validation): our own 3-class macro-F1 over supports, refutes and not enough info, reported on its own line beside SciTab and never merged with it; not the task's official per-table micro-F1
